bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder June 15, 2017

Chatham Sharks in the Park, sponsored by Chatham Merchants Association, is currently on display at Kate Gould Park until June 27. The sharks move to Eldredge Public Library, June 28 – August 18.

Guild of Harwich Artists member, Jeanne Tassinari, has two sponsored sharks on display this year: “Chatham Perk” and “Summer Sitters.”

Learn more about the Chatham Sharks in the Park Auction and bidding process on sharksinthepark.net.

Connect with Jeanne on Facebook “Not Just Cape Cod Art.”
